variants.title: Moessbauer spectrum of hematite (simulated instrument, illustrative parameters)
variants.sample: Alpha-Fe2O3 hematite, B_hf about 51.7 T, isomer shift 0.37 mm/s, quadrupole shift -0.20 mm/s (unsourced / illustrative)
variants.unknown: isomer shift, quadrupole splitting, hyperfine field
variants.note: A larger field spreads the sextet over almost 17 mm/s, and the shifts move its centre and make the pattern asymmetric. All three numbers are quoted from memory and unsourced.

source.title: Greenwood and Gibb, Moessbauer Spectroscopy (1971); hematite parameters quoted from memory (unsourced / illustrative)
